shortBio.en: Fleetwood Mac guitarist/arranger; fingerpicked acoustics and studio polish on Rumours.
shortBio.zh: Fleetwood Mac 吉他/编曲；Rumours 上的指弹吉他与录音室抛光。

body.en:
Born 1949. Joins 1975. Go Your Own Way and The Chain show layered acoustics, precise drums, stacked vocals.

Off/on Mac tenures after 1987; Rumours-era arrangement is the citation.
body.zh:
1949 年生。1975 加入。Go Your Own Way 与 The Chain 展示多层原声、精确鼓、堆叠人声。

1987 后离合；引用仍是 Rumours 时期编曲。

note.zh: 入 Mac 前二人组；未入编年史。
